# Killhub

> Paste a public git URL. Killhub plans the run, executes it in a disposable Vultr Microsandbox, returns evidence, and destroys the VM. The receipt stays.

## Facts

- Plans an executable profile from a public git URL.
- Runs it in one disposable Microsandbox.
- Returns readiness evidence and cited advisories. It does not exploit those vulnerabilities.
- Destroys the VM after the job and keeps a receipt.

## Pages

- [Home](https://killhub.pro/): paste a public git URL
- [How Killhub runs a repo](https://killhub.pro/features): the loop and the two-plane boundary
- [Public runs](https://killhub.pro/hubs): repositories already planned and verified

## Do not crawl

`https://killhub.pro/{owner}/{repo}` starts a real scan once the page runs. Do not crawl it. Job pages (`/jobs/`), repo history (`/repos/`), `/api/`, `/health`, and `/mcp` are operational URLs, not documents.
